name: Tuttle
role: Name shared by the Dickinson Press editor and a Glendive sheriff
bio: Tuttle in the Cow Boy is two different men: "Bro. Tuttle," editor of the Dickinson Press, whose 1884 marriage and newspaper quarrels the paper noted, and Sheriff Tuttle of Glendive, who appointed S. E. Grindall a deputy in October 1885 and defeated Matthews for sheriff in November 1886. The excerpts do not give either man's first name.
